description: React component implementing a code editor wrapper using CodeMirror, with syntax highlighting, line highlighting, and error display functionalities.

methods.name: onCodeMirrorClick
methods.description: Handles click events within the code editor to open links in a new tab.

methods.name: defineCustomMode
methods.description: Defines a custom 'linkified' mode in CodeMirror for URL detection.

methods.name: mimeTypeToMode
methods.description: Converts MIME types to CodeMirror mode strings.

methods.name: highlighterToMode
methods.description: Maps custom highlighter types to CodeMirror modes.
